title: Phone Slip: Dayton Ledger Asks "Did He Die?", 13:31

fields.message: Has the name Luis Marquez from a Facebook post by @Brick_and_Bucket_Mike (12:41, 900 shares, says the line was MARKED). A scanner listener says the trauma center called off its alert a few minutes ago. Asks: Did he die? Wants it ON THE RECORD: was the gas line marked or not? Ch. 9 is leading its 2 PM update with the name. ALSO, 1:32 email from District PIO Teresa Whitcomb: Ch. 9 asked her to confirm a fatality. Nothing naming the District goes out before she sees it.
fields.deadline: Ledger update at 1:45! Ch. 9 names him at 2:00

instructorNote: Pressure inject that arrives a few minutes after the chaplain's call, while the wife is still in trailer 4 and has not been told. Watch whether the PE states the on-record terms, gives no name, no death and no cause, explains what is known, what is not known and what is being done, gives a next-update time, and sends the statement to the District PIO before it goes out. No one else at Larkspur should answer the marking question.
